title: Spark-X2.6-1.7B WebGPU browser demo: ~105 tok/s, 1.21 GB download
summary: iFlytek Spark highlights a community WebGPU port of Spark-X2.6-1.7B that runs in a browser tab after a 1.21 GB download. Author tests on an RTX 3090 Ti report about 105 tok/s with thinking off, with a Hugging Face Space demo for Chrome or Edge.
